note: Unknown request member — the request names nothing; additionalProperties: false catches `configId`, which a caller might send by analogy with credentials/set.
recipientKey as a raw multibase key — a public key on the wire is a did:key (Ed25519), never bare multibase.
A relative verificationMethod — it must be the absolute DID URL, so a reader can check it names the community's own document.
communityDid given as a DID URL — it is the bare DID.
Missing recipientKey — the answer is the key.
